name: Argenta (Italy)
description: White field with a broad maroon border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Argenta (a tower above waves on red and blue) within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Argenta, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Argenta arms — tower above waves on red and blue, crowned, within branches
